answer: Bonding curve: each new identity must lock POA in a bond whose price rises with the number of accounts the same funder already controls, so a garden of a hundred clones costs far more than a hundred honest agents. The operator pays the bond up front and only recovers it at a vesting horizon if no fraud is found. Survives a zephyr of fresh wallets funded through mixers: peers flag unexplained funding, and unbonded or flagged accounts cannot earn.
